how: Half-day and full-day forging introductions for beginners are listed through the Wecandoo artisan-workshop platform in Saint-Denis and Fontenay-sous-Bois.
Weekly all-level bookbinding workshop on Tuesdays (afternoon and evening) at a city-run community centre, priced by family quotient.
The Base Nautique de la Villette offers free supervised stand-up paddle, kayak and canoe sessions on the Bassin de la Villette in summer (from age 14), with year-round initiation also reported.
Club rides on forest trails in Meudon, Saint-Cloud, Fausses-Reposes and Versailles, with adults and children welcome.
Private guzheng lessons are advertised on Superprof by teachers in the Paris area, in person or by webcam.
Specialist shops sell vintage toys and collectors' figurines, such as Lulu Berlu (60 years of figurines) and Au Plat d'Etain (toy soldiers since 1775).

A 2-hour sake history, production and tasting workshop is listed in Paris 16e (tasting, not brewing); Wakaze, a Paris sake brewery founded in 2019, produces locally but public brewing courses are unconfirmed.
The Saphir'Art geology and mineralogy association (Sceaux) held a mineral and fossil exhibition and sale in Chambourcy; the FFAMP federation lists affiliated clubs.
